content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 3.2 (p0040) auto-renews each Service Option Attachment for a term equal to the prior term unless either party gives 90 days' notice. That 90-day non-renewal window breaches the fallback ceiling of 60 days, so I flagged a deviation and proposed the single surgical change (90 → 60 days). The price-increase element is not engaged by the renewal clause (renewal is on existing terms), and IBM's separate § 13.1 unilateral price-change right — which carries a fee-free Customer exit — belongs to the change-of-terms rule and was not double-flagged. Renewal-term length mirroring the initial term is noted as a preferred-level point only.
